fields.name: displayName
fields.tooltip: Name shown in the debug menu and used to seed this spawner's random stream (so renaming reshuffles its layout).

fields.name: color
fields.tooltip: Tint of this spawner's debug rows.

fields.name: spacing
fields.tooltip: Metres of track between one spawn step and the next (min, max).

fields.name: startDistance
fields.tooltip: The first step lands between this distance and this plus the minimum spacing, so the launch stays clean.

fields.name: chance
fields.tooltip: Chance that a step spawns anything at all. 1 = every step.

fields.name: laserPrefab
fields.tooltip: The emitter pair (PF_LaserSystem): LaserA and LaserB, each with a ShootPoint child, carrying a LaserBeam. One instance per beam — three for the triple gate.

fields.name: definition
fields.tooltip: Beam size, variant weights, rotor speed and the look. Cloned at play, so the asset is never edited by a run.

fields.name: clearance
fields.tooltip: Clear road kept between a gate and every feature (ramp + its longest landing, loop, tube), flat sweep and the final run-up, either side. Must stay under the settle margin (two segments), which is what guarantees no feature is decided behind an already placed gate.

fields.name: onFlatSweeps
fields.tooltip: Gates may stand on a FLAT sweep (no bank, the outer wall gone, grip tested). Off = the clearance is kept round every flat sweep too — on a track authored with mostly flat sweeps that leaves few spots.

fields.name: onOpenEdges
fields.tooltip: Gates may stand where the road has no wall (an open straight, the outer edge of a flat sweep). Off = walled road only.
